beacon.title: Beacon
lines: Build a pyramid of iron, gold, emerald, diamond or netherite blocks. The block type is cosmetic; mixing is fine.
Primary powers: Speed and Haste (level 1 pyramid), Resistance and Jump Boost (level 2), Strength (level 3).
Pay one iron ingot, gold ingot, emerald, diamond or netherite ingot to set the powers.
A level 4 pyramid unlocks the secondary power: Regeneration, or primary power level II.
Effects last 9 seconds plus 2 per pyramid level and refresh every 4 seconds.

cartography.title: Cartography Table
lines: Zoom out: a filled map and paper.
Copy: a filled map and an empty map.
Lock: a filled map and a glass pane, so the map can no longer change.
In Bedrock Edition you can also add pointers, make empty maps and rename maps.

grindstone.title: Grindstone
lines: One enchanted item removes all enchantments except curses and gives experience back.
Two items of the same type combine into one repaired, unenchanted item. Prior-work cost resets.
Custom names are kept. Curses are not removed.

horse.title: Horse, Donkey, and Mule
lines: Put a saddle in the saddle slot to ride the animal.
Horses take armor in the armor slot.
Donkeys and mules take a chest to gain extra inventory space.

inventory.title: Inventory
lines: The 2x2 grid crafts items. The result slot shows what you can make.
The armor slots on the side hold your helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots.
The off-hand slot holds a second item, such as a shield or a totem.

loom.title: Loom
lines: Put a banner and a dye in, then pick a pattern.
Some patterns need a banner pattern item in the third slot: Flower Charge, Creeper Charge, Skull Charge, Thing, Snout, Globe, Field Masoned, Bordure Indented, Flow and Guster.
The banner pattern item is not used up.

trade.title: Villager Trading
lines: Pick a trade from the list. Each trade shows what you pay and what you get.
A trade runs out after its uses and restocks as the villager's day goes on.
